text:
sophia-support: Heads-up — free-trial request from acme-corp (acct 5392) is on hold with code FRAUD_TRIAL_HOLD_302. Ticket #T-4921 attached in Zendesk. Customer sent incorporation docs but our automated checks flagged the signup IP as a TOR exit / proxy and the signup email domain looks disposable. Need guidance on manual override.

fraud-bot: Auto-detect summary: disposable_email=true; vpn_proxy=true; risk_score=78; rule_trigger=GEO_MISMATCH_HIGH; bin_mismatch=true. Recommend manual review.

mike-ops: Can you paste the ticket link + the uploaded doc filenames? Also, any reproducible request/response snippet would help.

sophia-support: Ticket link: https://redwood.zendesk.com/agent/tickets/4921. Uploaded: acme-incorporation.pdf, owner-id-photo.jpg. Repro snippet (redacted):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/free_trial 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"email":"devteam@mailinator.com","company":"acme-corp","card_last4":"4242"}'
# Response: 403 {"code":"FRAUD_TRIAL_HOLD_302","message":"Trial flagged by risk engine"}
```

Headers from the original request (strip PII):
```
X-Forwarded-For: 185.220.101.10
User-Agent: okhttp/3.12.1
Accept-Language: en-US
```

eli-aml: Quick glance — BIN for the card doesn't match the billing country (card BIN: 5163 -> issued DE, billing country US). Combined with TOR exit IP and disposable email, that's why score high. If docs look legit we can do a controlled manual grant: 7-day trial, require phone verification and restrict API key permissions (no production keys).

karen-cs: Customer is a small startup, asking for a POC this week. If we can do a temporary grant (low-risk), that will keep momentum. They already uploaded incorporation docs.

tim-dev: I reproduced the 403 locally using the curl above. Server side id: request_id=rx-0a1b2c3d. No other error logs.

anna-legal: If we grant access, capture explicit acceptance of TOS and keep the KYC docs attached to the account. Also record a short rationale for the override.

eli-aml: Proposed action: phone verify owner (I can call, ETA 30m). If successful: apply tag TRIAL_OVERRIDE_TEMP_7D, create restricted API key, and set monitoring alert for any sudden token usage. I'll add a note to the fraud audit log.

mike-ops: I'll update the Zendesk ticket with the proposed steps and flag ops playbook entry. If eli confirms, go ahead and patch the flag — please include my handle in the audit. :white_check_mark:

sophia-support: Thanks. I'll email the customer with the next steps (phone verify window, expected turnaround ~1hr after verification). cc: @karen-cs.

eli-aml: Phone verification done — owner confirmed company address and provided incorporation number matching registry. Marking for manual override. Applying TRIAL_OVERRIDE_TEMP_7D now.

mike-ops: Override applied and restricted API key issued (log id: log-775). Documented in ticket T-4921. :lock: :white_check_mark:

sophia-support: Closing loop — customer notified, trial granted for 7 days with restrictions. Will monitor and escalate if anomalous activity. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
